title: Sr. Business Analyst
description: Overview: Senior ServiceNow Business Analyst We’re looking for a Senior ServiceNow Business Analyst to lead requirements for CSM implementations and enhancements. You’ll own the analysis between customer service leaders and the delivery team, turning service needs into buildable requirements for case management, customer engagement, and service delivery, and guiding the team from discovery through UAT and go-live. Responsibilities: Key Responsibilities Lead requirements gathering for CSM implementations and enhancements through workshops, interviews, and process reviews with customer service leaders, agents, and process owners. Translate customer service needs into functional and technical requirements that fit ServiceNow CSM capabilities and limitations. Document case management, customer journey, and service process flows, including routing, escalation, and resolution workflows. Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation, and set quality standards for BA deliverables on the team. Define and validate configuration needs for case forms, workflows, business rules, and integrations. Own UAT planning and coordination, including test strategy, test case review, and sign-off on outcomes. Manage requirements traceability through the delivery lifecycle and flag scope or priority changes early. Identify process improvements using CSM best practices, such as self-service, knowledge management, and SLA management, and present recommendations to stakeholders. Mentor junior analysts and support end-user training and knowledge transfer. Requirements: Required Qualifications 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with a track record of leading requirements on enterprise programs. 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience, including at least 3 years in CSM. Deep understanding of CSM functionality, including case management, customer service portal, entitlements, and SLAs, and how these affect design decisions. Proven experience writing user stories, functional specifications, and process documentation at an enterprise level. Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery and working within sprint and release cadences. Strong ITSM/ITIL process knowledge, particularly incident, request, and problem management as they relate to customer service. Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and executive communication skills. Nice to Have ServiceNow CSM certification, such as Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management. Experience with CRM integrations, such as Salesforce or Dynamics 365. Knowledge of omnichannel support tools, such as Virtual Agent, chat, and email routing. Experience mentoring or leading a team of analysts. Prior consulting or client-facing experience in pre-sales or solutioning.

Strong understanding of B2B marketing processes, including campaign execution, segmentation, lead capture, lead scoring, routing, nurture programs, and attribution. Experience gathering requirements and creating process maps, user stories, functional specifications, and test plans. Working knowledge of marketing and CRM data structures, integrations, APIs, consent management, and data governance principles. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Salesforce Marketing Cloud or Salesforce Administrator certification. Additional Skills Proficient in MS Office applications, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc. Familiar with operating systems, such as Windows, etc. Working knowledge of Agile framework for marketing Work Requirements Compliance to all relevant HID Global policies and procedures related to Quality, Security, Safety, Business Continuity, and Environmental systems. Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers. title: Salesforce Business Analyst
description: Role purpose Teceze is seeking a Salesforce Business Analyst to ensure client delivery teams solve clearly defined business problems. You will connect stakeholders, processes and delivery requirements, maintain traceability from business objectives to accepted outcomes, and help users validate and adopt changes. Key responsibilities Identify stakeholders, decision owners and users; plan discovery activities that capture both management objectives and day-to-day operational needs. Run interviews and workshops to document current processes, pain points, controls, exceptions and opportunities for improvement. Define future-state processes with business owners and consultants, documenting what changes in systems, responsibilities and ways of working. Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria and business rules; identify nonfunctional needs and route technical questions to the appropriate specialists. Maintain traceability between business objectives, requirements, solution decisions, test scenarios and acceptance evidence. Support backlog prioritisation using business value, risk, dependencies and effort estimates provided by delivery teams. Analyse data definitions, quality issues and reporting requirements; validate that proposed measures reflect the intended business outcomes. Assess requirement changes, clarify scope impacts and present options for stakeholder decisions without silently expanding delivery commitments. Plan and coordinate UAT, prepare representative scenarios, support users, triage defects and obtain documented acceptance from business owners. Support communications, training and adoption planning; assess post-release feedback and recommend improvements against the original objectives. Required skills and experience Demonstrable experience taking requirements from discovery through delivery and acceptance on Salesforce or related CRM projects. Strong process modelling, user-story writing, acceptance-criteria definition and requirements traceability skills. Working knowledge of Salesforce objects, relationships, permissions, Flow and reporting sufficient to discuss feasible business solutions. Ability to analyse datasets, identify inconsistent definitions and communicate the business impact of data quality problems. Experience with Agile delivery and work-management tools, including backlog refinement, change analysis and UAT coordination. Strong facilitation, written communication and stakeholder negotiation skills, including managing ambiguity and conflicting priorities. Preferred qualifications Salesforce Business Analyst credentials or relevant recognised business analysis qualifications. Experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence and process-modelling applications. Experience analysing AI-assisted workflows, customer data use cases or industry-specific sales and service operations. Education: Degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience. Evidence of successful delivery is more important than certification alone.
